content.text:
I submitted **index 13 (Sb fraction 0.448)**. It had the highest EQE I measured, 1.53%. I used all 5 EQE measurements and 3 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0.242 | 0.46 |
| 10 | 0.350 | 1.39 |
| **13** | **0.448** | **1.53** |
| 20 | 0.675 | 0.033 |
| 26 | 0.816 | 0.060 |

- **Where the good region is:** EQE rises from Sb 0.24 to 0.45, then drops to almost nothing at the Sb-rich end. The Ni-rich compositions in the middle of the line did far better. Index 20, the closest composition to the known NiSb₂O₆ phase, was almost inactive.
- **XRD:** the patterns at Sb 0.19, 0.35 and 0.52 are essentially identical, so the same crystal phase runs across that whole range. I didn't compare them against the database patterns, so I can't say which phase it is.
- **Uncertainty:** the peak could sit somewhere I didn't measure, between 0.45 and about 0.55 or between 0.35 and 0.45. EQE had not started falling at index 13. I had no EQE budget left to check indices 14–16, so the line's true best may be a little higher than 1.53%.
